# Filtered Array

Source: [4610](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4610); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Filtered Array](../../api/values/filtered-array.md).

<a id="wiki-4610-n1"></a>

- Filtered Array returns a new array without changing the original; its condition runs for each element with Current Array Element bound to that element.

<a id="wiki-4610-n2"></a>

- Filter condition need not depend on the current element: an all-or-none visibility filter can hide/show a long-lived effect without destroying/recreating it.

Source limitations:

- Visibility trick also requires suitable Visible To reevaluation, which prose does not state explicitly.
